name: Glycerin + Hypromellose + Polyethylene glycol + Tetrahydrozoline + Zinc Sulfate
indication_description:
This eye drop is indicated-
  • For the relief of discomfort and redness of the eye due to minor eye irritations.
  • Relieves dryness of the eye.
  • For the temporary relief of burning and irritation due to exposure to wind or sun.
  • For protection against further irritation.
dosage_description:
• Put 1 to 2 drops in the affected eye(s) up to 4 times a daily
  • Children under 6 years of age: ask a doctor
contraindications_description:
Stop use and ask a doctor if
  • you feel eye pain
  • changes in vision occur
  • redness or irritation of the eye lasts
  • the condition worsens or lasts more than 72 hours
side_effects_description: Possible side effects include: temporary stinging or burning; redness, itching and watering of the eye
pregnancy_and_lactation_description: If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.
precautions_description:
When using this product-
  • pupils may become enlarged temporarily
  • overuse may cause more eye redness
  • remove contact lenses before using
  • do not use if this solution changes color or becomes cloudy
  • do not touch tip of container to any surface to avoid contamination
  • replace cap after each use
storage_conditions_description: Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
